title: Python SCHC maximum packet constant exceeds normative profile ceiling
description: python/src/lichen/schc/fragment.py declares MAX_PACKET_SIZE = 24000 while the normative LICHEN SCHC fragmentation ceiling and Rust shared constant are 23562 bytes (2 windows x 63 tiles x 187 bytes). Current default/profile arithmetic usually enforces 23562 independently, so the stale constant is not presently the primary enforcement path, but it exposes a conflicting public assumption that future callers or validation paths can reuse.
acceptance_criteria: Remove the stale constant or derive/export MAX_PACKET_SIZE from the same authoritative profile constants used by other implementations so its value is exactly 23562. Ensure sender and receiver validation use the shared value where applicable. Add focused Python boundary tests proving 23562 bytes is accepted with an appropriately configured receiver and 23563 bytes is rejected, and retain cross-implementation constant/vector consistency with Rust and C.
